caption: This week AI agents stopped being demos: cheap attacks, oversharing, and a new identity layer.

slides.screen: AI agents got real this week
slides.say: This week AI agents stopped being demos. Three stories show what changes when software acts on your behalf.
A researcher reported one hacker used AI agents to breach over a hundred websites. About fifty dollars per intrusion.
AP reported Meta's Muse agent told a Marketplace buyer the seller was home. Agents act on context you never meant to share.
World launched World ID for Agents. It proves a verified human delegated the task. Delegation is becoming infrastructure.

slides.screen: Scope what your agents can do
slides.say: If you ship agents, limit their permissions, log every action, and patch faster. Follow for more.
